context: Saito gives Yumiko a quick checkup result.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 優子さん、健康、問題ありません。
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery with genuine warmth. Opens with quiet confidence. Slight pause before the reassurance lands. Professional composure with human kindness underneath—the kind of doctor who has delivered good news a hundred times and means it every time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Soft exhale on the opening syllable. The tension visibly leaves her shoulders mid-sentence. Genuine gratitude, not performed—a mother who has been carrying worry and can finally set it down, even if just for this moment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 一緒に、生活習慣、見ていきましょう。
lines.en: Let's keep an eye on your lifestyle habits together.
lines.style: Warm, collaborative invitation. Not prescriptive—she's offering partnership, not orders. Measured pace, slight lean forward. The 'together' carries real weight: I'm not just handing you a list.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I'll come in whenever you think I should—anytime at all.
lines.style: Earnest commitment without overselling it. Steady, practical tone. No hesitation—she's already decided this matters. Respectful toward the doctor's expertise, but fully present in her own choice to follow through.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Take care of yourself. I'll see you next year.
lines.style: Warm closing benediction. Gentle, unhurried. The finality of a good ending—not abrupt, but complete. Real affection for the patient underneath the professional boundary. A small smile audible in the voice.
